spans.s: , न्य्-अ᳙क्न, न्यग्, &c. See under 1. and 2. न्य्-अञ्च्.
न्य्-अ᳙क् ind. downwards, down, RV.; ŚBr.
with √ कृ, to bring down, humble

(न्यग्) with √ भू, to humble one's self, be humble or modest:
Caus. -भावयति = √ कृ, Pāṇ. i, 3, 70, Sch. (cf. न्यक्-. and न्यग्- above).
न्य्-अ᳙क्त mfn. anointed, decorated (?), AV. xiv, 2, 33 (RV. व्य्-अ॑क्त)
imbued with, having the nature of (gen.), ŚBr.
(hardly fr. नि + अक्ष; but cf. Pāṇ. vi, 2, 192, Sch.) low, inferior, L.
anything inherent in, a mark, sign, TBr.; ŚBr.; ĀpŚr.
anything which resembles or is like, a kind of (gen. or comp.), ŚBr.; Lāṭy.
(ifc. having anything as secondary, mentioning it only accidentally, ŚāṅkhŚr.)
a mole or spot upon the body, Suśr.
2. न्य्-अ᳙ञ्च् mf(नी॑ची) n (fr. नि + 2. अञ्च्) (न्य्-अक्). going or directed downwards, bent down, RV. &c. &c.
lying with the face downwards (opp. to उत्-तान), ŚBr.
न्य्-˚अङ्क॑ m. du. a partic. part of a carriage, TS.; TBr.
a deer, an antelope, VS.; MBh. &c.
N. of a Muni and a Cakra-vartin, L.
न्य्-˚अङ्कु—सारिणी f. (with बृहती) N. of two kinds of metre, RPrāt.
न्य्-˚अ॑ञ्चन mf(ई)n. curve, recess, hollow, hiding-place, RV.; AV. (˚नैषि॑न् mfn. seeking a h˚-pl˚, MaitrS.)
a partic. mark on a measuring-cord, Śulb.
न्य्-˚अञ्चनैषि॑न् mfn., seeking a h˚-pl˚, MaitrS.
न्यक्—करण n. lowering, degrading, treating with disrespect, W.
न्यक्—कार m. humiliation, contempt, disregard, Hariv.; BhP.
न्यक्—कृत mfn. humbled, treated with contempt or contumely, Rājat.; Kathās.
न्यक्—कृत्य ind. having humbled, by humbling, Rājat.
न्यग्—जाति mfn. of a low or inferior race, W.
न्यग्—भाव m. being brought or coming down, Sarvad.
being sunk or absorbed in (loc.), ib.
न्यग्—भावन n. humiliation, contempt, Pāṇ. i, 3, 70, Sch.
न्यग्—भावयितृ m. one who lowers or humbles, Daś.
न्यग्—भूत mfn. being low, humble, MBh.
न्यग्—भूत्वा ind. having humbled (or by humbling) one's self, ib.

न्यग्—रो॑ध m. (√ रुध् = रुह्), ‘growing downwards’ the Banyan or Indian fig-tree, Ficus Indica (it belongs to the क्षीर-वृक्षस्, q.v.; fibres descend from its branches to the earth and there take root and form new stems), AV. &c. &c.
Prosopis Spicigera or Mimosa Suma, L.
a fathom (measured by the arms extended), L.
N. of a son of Kṛṣṇa, BhP.
of a son of Ugra-sena (also ˚धक), Hariv.; Pur.
of a Brāhman, a monastery and a village, Lalit.
न्यग्—रो॑धा (आ), f. Salvinia Cucullata or some other plant, Car.
न्यग्—रो॑धी (ई or इका), f. id., L.
न्यग्—रोध—क्षीर n. the milky juice of the Indian fig-tree, Suśr.
न्यग्—रोध—परिमण्डल mfn. being a fathom in circumference, MatsyaP.
न्यग्—रोध—परिमण्डला f. an elegant woman, L.
न्यग्—रोध—परिमण्ड˚ल-ता f. the having a waist like a fig-tree, (with, Buddh. one of the 32 signs of perfection,
the having a waist like a fig-tree (one of the 32 signs of perfection),
न्यग्—रोध—पाद m. N. of a man
न्यग्—रो˚धक mfn. g. ऋश्यादि (cf. also above)
न्यग्—रो˚धिक mfn. g. कुमुदादि and प्रेक्षादि.
न्यग्—रो˚धिन् mfn. g. कुमुदादि and प्रेक्षादि.

न्य्-√ अञ्ज् P. -अनक्ति (pf. Ā. -आनजे ind.p. -अज्य), to anoint, besmear, AV.; Kāty.;
 Ā. to creep in, conceal one's self among (loc.), RV.
an Añjali which is directed downwards, TĀr.
or n. proximity (cf. Pāṇ. vi, 2, 181, Sch.)
going off, destruction, loss, waste, Pāṇ. iii, 3, 37, Sch.; L.

that into which a thing goes back i.e. an original type, standard, method, rule, (esp.) a general or universal rule, model, axiom, system, plan, manner, right or fit manner or way, fitness, propriety, TS.; Br.; Mn.; MBh. &c. (न्यायेन ind. and ˚यात् ind. either ‘in the right manner, regularly, duly’, or ifc. ‘after the manner of, by way of’)
a lawsuit, legal proceeding, judicial sentence, judgement, Mṛcch.; Pañc.

a logical or syllogistic argument or inference (consisting of a combination of enthymeme and syllogism, and so having, according to the Naiyāyikas 5 members, viz. प्रतिज्ञा, हेतु, उदाहरण, उपनय, निगमन, or according to the Vedāntins 3 members)

a system of philosophy delivered by Gotama or Gautama (it is one of the six दर्शनस्, q.v., and is perhaps so called, because it ‘goes into’ all subjects physical and metaphysical according to the above syllogistic method treated of in one division of the system; its branch is called Vaiśeṣika)
likeness, analogy, a popular maxim or apposite illustration (cf. काकाक्षि-, घुणाक्षर-, दण्डापूप. &c.)
mf(आ)n. regular, customary, usual, correct, right, fit, proper (often with an infin. which then has a pass. sense), Lāṭy.; Mn.; MBh. &c.; also w.r. for न्याय.
entry, entrance- or gathering-place, receptacle, RV.
न्य्-अ᳙र्ण्ण mfn. (√ अर्द्) dissolved, gone, ŚBr. (W. ‘asked, solicited; injured’).
न्य्-अ᳙र्बुद n. one hundred millions, AV. &c.
न्य्-अ᳙र्बुदि m. N. of a divine being of combative propensities, AV.
the accentless vowel at the end of the first member of a compound, VPrāt.
न्य्-अव-√ चर् P. -चरति, to enter into, penetrate, MW.
न्य्-अव-√ सृज् P. -सृजति, to pour out, shed forth, R.
न्य्-˚असन n. putting down, depositing, placing, arranging, Sāh.
न्य्-˚असनीय mfn. to be put or placed, AgP.
न्य्-˚अस्त mfn. thrown or cast or laid down, put, placed, fixed, inserted, applied, deposited, committed
given up, resigned, Mn.; MBh.; Kāv.
having the low tone (as a vowel), RPrāt.
न्य्-˚अस्त—चिह्न mf(आ)n. one who has relinquished one's marks or characteristics, destitute of external signs, Ragh. ii, 7
न्य्-˚अस्त—दण्ड mfn. ‘one who has laid down the rod’, meek, harmless, R.
न्य्-˚अस्त—देह mfn. ‘one who has laid down the body’, dead, ib.
न्य्-˚अस्त—शस्त्र mfn. ‘one who has laid down the weapons’, averse from strife, peaceful, Mn. iii, 192
न्य्-˚अस्त—शस्त्र m. the Pitṛs or deified progenitors, L.
न्य्-˚अस्त—वाद mfn. one who has ceased to speak, ceasing to speak about (प्रति), Hariv.
न्य्-˚अस्˚तार्त्विज्य mfn. where the Ṛtvij have laid down their office, ŚāṅkhŚr.
न्य्-˚अस्तव्य mfn. to be put down or placed or fixed or established, Vāstuv.; Hcat.
1. न्य्-˚अस्य mfn. to be laid down or deposited or delivered or appointed to (loc.), MBh.
2. न्य्-˚अस्य ind. having laid down or deposited &c., ib.
putting down or in, placing, fixing, inserting, applying, impressing, drawing, painting, writing down, MBh.; Kāv. &c. (cf. अक्षर-, खुर-, चरण-, नख-, पद-., पाद-., बीज-, रेखा-)
putting away, taking off, laying aside, MBh.; Hariv.; Daś.; BhP. (cf. देह-, शरीर-, शस्त्र-)
any deposit or pledge, Mn.; Yājñ.; MBh. &c.
written or literal text (cf. यथा-न्यासम्), Pat.
consigning or intrusting anything to the mind, W.
mental appropriation or assignment of various parts of the body to tutelary deities,
N. of sev. works., (esp.) of a Comm. on Kāś.
न्य्-आस—कार m. the author of the Comm. on Kāś. called Nyāsa i.e. Jinendra-buddhi
न्य्-आस—कृत् m. the author of the Comm. on Kāś. called Nyāsa i.e. Jinendra-buddhi
न्य्-आस—खण्ड m. n. N. of wk.
न्य्-आस—तिलक m. n. N. of wk.
न्य्-आस—धारक m. the holder of a deposit, Mn.
न्य्-आस—धारिन् m. the holder of a deposit, Mn.
न्य्-आस—भूत mfn. being (or that which is) a deposit, MBh.
न्य्-आस—लोप m. wasting a d˚, ib.
न्य्-आस—हर m. robber of a deposit, BhP.
न्य्-आ˚सापह्नव m. repudiation of a d˚, MW.
न्य्-˚आसित mfn. (fr. Caus.) caused to lay or put down, BhP.
न्य्-˚आसिन् mfn. one who has abandoned all worldly concerns, ib.
न्य्-˚आसी-√ कृ to make a deposit, deposit anything with a person, Kum.; Kathās.; Rājat.
or n. the closing day (only loc.), AV.
न्य्-आ-√ कृ (only Impv. -कुरु), to hold back, RV. x, 19, 2.
न्य्-आ-√ गम् (only Impv. -गतम्), to come down towards, RV. viii, 5, 13.
(Pāṇ. vii, 3, 5, Sch.) mfn. (fr. न्यग्र्˚) being or situated at the roots of the Ficus Indica.
(Vop. vii, 4; 18) mfn. (fr. न्यग्र्˚) being or situated at the roots of the Ficus Indica.
न्य्-आ-√ द्रु P. -द्रवति, to run downwards, MaitrS.
न्य्-आ-√ धा (only pf. -दधुर्), to put down, fix, establish, appoint, RV. viii, 73, 2.
न्य्-आ-√ धृ only pf. Ā. -दध्रे, to be directed towards or fixed upon (loc.), RV. viii, 17, 13.
न्य्-आ-√ नी (Pot. -नयेत्), to bring back, restore, AV. vii, 38, 5.
(अम्), ind. after a finite verb expresses either censure or repetition, Pāṇ. viii, 1, 27.
ind., either ‘in the right manner, regularly, duly’, or ifc. ‘after the manner of, by way of’
ind., either ‘in the right manner, regularly, duly’, or ifc. ‘after the manner of, by way of’

न्य्-आय—कल्प-लता or न्य्-आय—कल्प-ल˚तिका, f. N. of wks.
न्य्-आय—कुलिश m. n. N. of wk.
न्य्-आय—कुसुमाञ्जलि m. (-कारिका f. -प्रकाश m. -विकाश m. -विवेक, m.) N. of wk.
न्य्-आय—कोकिल (?), m. N. of a Buddh. teacher.
न्य्-आय—कौस्तुभ m. n. N. of wk.
न्य्-आय—चूडामणि m. (-प्रभा f.) N. of wk.
न्य्-आय—तस् ind. in a fitting manner, as is fit or proper, according to right or justice, Mn.; Yājñ.; R.
न्य्-आय—देव m. N. of an author, Cat.
न्य्-आय—निर्वपण m. N. of Śiva, MBh. xiii, 1239.
न्य्-आय—पञ्चानन m. N. of Jaya-rāma, Cat.
न्य्-आय—पथ m. pl. the different philosophical systems, BhP.
न्य्-आय—प्रस्थान-मार्ग m. pl. the roads leading towards (i.e. the works treating of) the different philosophical systems (cf. -पथ).
न्य्-आय—वत् mfn. acting rightly, behaving properly, MBh.; R.
न्य्-आय—वर्तिन् mfn. well behaved, acting with propriety, Mn.; Yājñ.
न्य्-आय—वागीश and न्य्-आय—वाचस्पति, m. N. of an author on rhet.
न्य्-आय—वागीश and न्य्-आय—वाचस्पति, m. N. of an author on rhet.
न्य्-आय—विद् m. one who knows what is fit or proper, Āpast.
न्य्-आय—विद्या f. ‘science of what is right’, logic, Nyāyas. Comm.
न्याय—विरुद्ध or न्याय—विरोधिन्, mfn. inconsistent with logical argument, Kāvyād.
न्याय—विरुद्ध or न्याय—विरोधिन्, mfn. inconsistent with logical argument, Kāvyād.
न्याय—विरोध m. inconsistency with logical argument, ib.
न्य्-आय—विहित mfn. prescribed by rule, Lāṭy.
न्य्-आय—शास्त्र n. the doctrine of the Nyāya school of philosophy, Sarvad.
न्य्-आय—सम्बद्ध mfn. connected with reason, rational, logical (as an argument), R.
न्य्-आय—सारिणी f. right or fit behaviour, L.
a woman acting or judging rightly, W.
न्य्-आय—सिद्धा˚न्त—पञ्चानन m. N. of a Viśva-nātha, Cat.
न्य्-आय—सिद्धा˚न्त—वागीश m. N. of a Gadā-dhara, ib.
न्य्-आय—सूत्र n. the aphorisms of the Nyāya philosophy by Gautama
न्य्-आय—सूत्र—वृत्ति f. a commentary on these aphorisms,
rightly come in or acquired (as money), MBh.
‘receptacle of justice’, an example of virtue or propriety, W.
semblance of a reason, sophism, Nyāyas. Comm.
‘ornament of justice’, N. of Śrī-govinda and of Śri-maheśvara (also -भट्ट), Cat.
walking rightly on the straight path (-ता f.), Lalit.
न्याय्य—दण्ड mfn. punishing justly (-त्व n.), Gaut.
न्य्-आ-√ विश् (only pf. -विविशुर्), to enter into (loc.), RV. x, 56, 4.
न्य्-आ-√ वृत् Caus. -वर्तयति, to make a person desist from (abl.), keep back, prevent, Kathās.
न्य्-आ-√ व्यध् P. -विध्यति, to cause to burst forth, let loose, set free, MW.
न्य्-आ-√ सद् P. -सीदति (pf. -ससाद ind.p. -सद्य), to sit down near or in or upon (loc. or acc.), RV.
(or -आ॑-नि॑-ष्˚), sitting down or on, seated on
